verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a community report of a user doing remote support on a Win10 machine from Linux with AnyDesk, which shows host and viewer running on different operating systems. No first-party docs in the pack list supported desktop or mobile platforms, and a 2014 launch-era comment noted no Mac version at the time. missing for 10: first-party documentation of supported platforms, evidence of macOS support, evidence of mobile clients (iOS/Android), documented cross-OS host/viewer compatibility.

support.subject: As a power user, clients cover the desktop and mobile platforms I use, and host and viewer can run on different operating systems

citations.quote: occasional remote support for a club's Win10 machine from Linux
